==About==

Crafting {{i|Tasty Cakes}} at a {{i|Baking Table}} will make a {{i|Tasty Cakes Dough}} which can then be baked in a {{i|Bread Oven}} to produce a Tasty Cakes. Preparing Foods on a Baking Table removes a small amount of [[Insanity]] and has a chance of giving you an {{i|Eloped Gingerbread Man}}. When baking Foods in a Bread Oven there is a chance for them to become {{i|Animal Crackers}} instead. Tasty Cakes is [[Gluttony#Double Variable Recipe|Double Variable Recipe]].
